Jordan Park in Atlantic Beach

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:20
Instaread
Free Things To Do in Jacksonville, Jacksonville Parks, Play Like a Local, Playgrounds / By Jacksonville Beach Moms / July 28, 2026

Tucked away in a quiet Atlantic Beach neighborhood, Jordan Park is one of those hidden gems that feels like a true community space. While it may not be the largest park in Northeast Florida, what it lacks in size it more than makes up for in charm, accessibility, family-friendly amenities, and great shaded playground.

Located on just over an acre of shaded, wooded land, Jordan Park offers a peaceful setting that’s perfect for a relaxed afternoon outdoors. One of the standout features for families is the large playground area, giving kids plenty of room to climb, slide, and burn off energy. Surrounded by mature trees, the playground provides a bit of natural shade, something every Jacksonville parent can appreciate during the warmer months.

Jordan Park is More Than Just a Playground

Beyond the playground, the park is well-equipped for gatherings and everyday play. Covered picnic pavilions and on-site grills make it an easy choice for birthday parties, weekend lunches, or casual meetups with friends. There’s also a basketball court, which is often a hub of activity for older kids and teens looking to shoot hoops or join a pickup game. Outdoor restrooms add convenience, especially for families planning to stay awhile.

One of the most unique aspects of Jordan Park is its strong connection to the surrounding community. The on-site community center serves as a gathering place for local programs and events, including after-school care, tutoring, and summer camps for kids. This makes the park more than just a place to play, it’s a space where families can connect, learn, and grow together.

Another fun feature you won’t find at every park is the musical garden, designed to be inclusive and engaging for kids of all abilities. It’s a simple but meaningful addition that encourages creativity and sensory play, making the park feel welcoming to everyone.

Overall, Jordan Park is a great option for families looking for a low-key, local spot to spend time outdoors. Whether you’re meeting friends at the playground, hosting a picnic, or stopping by for a quick play session, it offers just the right mix of amenities and community spirit. It may be small, but Jordan Park proves that sometimes the best parks are the ones that feel like home.

Jordan Park is located at 1825 Francis Ave, Atlantic Beach, FL 32233.
